# flutter_data_kit

Pub workspace: core contracts + Dio/Supabase/Firebase/Drift adapters. Depends
on lemsa_core_kit (AppFailure, Change). Core has no vendor SDKs. Adapters map
vendor exceptions to AppFailure. Drift owns mapDrift, DriftSyncQueue,
deleteUserData. PagedList mixin + ref.cacheFor (do not cache failed fetches).
FVM 3.35.7.
